title: Vault: choose the new visual world
question: New world, colors pinned (teal 0E7C7B + ember E8562A stay law). The roll dealt Sign-Painter's Cairo. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Sign-Painter's Cairo
options.lineage: hand-painted shop signs & cinema billboards of Cairo streets
options.thesis: Every screen is a freshly painted wall — flat committed teal panels, monumental block-letter money, ember the single hot spot.
options.viewport: Dashboard opens on a committed teal wall carrying the month's total in monumental numerals; expenses sit below as flat painted strips, one voice each; the ember FAB alone burns.
options.risk: Paint energy can crowd number-scanning — every strip must hold exactly one voice.

raised.raise: Tracked caps micro-labels act as registration furniture, quieting the paint around every figure.
Sections join along scored diagonal seams, not plain gutters — crease discipline as structure.
One display family at exactly two sizes: the monumental money mass, everything else yielded.

regions.label: teal painted wall · month total monumental

options.label: Khayamiya Patchwork
options.thesis: The dashboard is a sewn panel field — every stat and budget its own saturated cloth patch, stitch borders carrying structure.
options.viewport: Totals and budgets arrive as stitched patches of solid color; opening the app feels like unfolding a market awning, ember reserved for capture.
options.risk: Pattern density is the honest risk — patches must never outshout the money figures.

options.label: Signal Bench
options.lineage: CRT oscilloscope on an engineer's bench
options.thesis: Spending is a trace — teal waveform over an etched graticule, ember reserved for armed and warning readouts.
options.viewport: Month view as a locked trace over ten divisions; knobs step timebase and category; seven-segment totals glow.
options.case: Holds product clarity — numbers become instrument readouts; loses identification: Egyptians live on phones, not signal benches.
options.risk: Instrument coolness reads cold for daily money care.

options.label: Gate Board & Stub
options.lineage: departure boards paired with punched ticket stubs
options.thesis: Every expense a punched stub; the month a live board that reranks in place when anything changes.
options.viewport: Fixed-column board ranks spending; each row a stub segment; changed amounts flash ember and hold until seen.
options.case: Strongest pure-clarity fusion — tabular figures and change-hold states map straight onto sync and edits; loses identification to the painted street.
options.risk: Transit neutrality undersells the warmth Egyptians bring to money.

options.label: Miura Fold
options.case: Fuses poorly: deployable-sheet drama outruns a glanceable ledger.
options.kept: Scored-seam structural honesty — donated as diagonal section joins.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.case: Fuses poorly: atmosphere-as-state muddies money truth.
options.kept: Named, labeled light bands instead of raw color signals.

options.label: Cracktro Queue
options.case: Fuses poorly: demo-scene nostalgia means nothing to the street, and a black void is the opposite of the brief.
options.kept: Two-size typographic economy on one shared baseline clock.

options.label: Design Annual Plates
options.lineage: a design annual's plate section on uncoated stock
options.case: Fuses poorly: near-white restraint is the exact complaint being fixed.
options.kept: Registration furniture — hairlines, crosshairs, tracked caps labels.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What fintech ships everywhere — clean cards, soft shadows, one blue — executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Balance card up top, transactions list below, chart mid-page — at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
